# `network/peerTickets/PeerTicketStore.js`

> **Source:** `engine/network/peerTickets/PeerTicketStore.js`

network/peerTickets/PeerTicketStore.js — local reconnect memory (network plan §38). In-memory only; callers persist via their own storage (e.g. webgpu-os/storage/AppSandbox) and rehydrate with addPeerTicket() on boot — engine/network stays storage-agnostic (see GroupLedger.js for the same pattern).

## Functions

### `createPeerTicketStore()`

Create an empty peer ticket store.

### `addPeerTicket(store, signedTicket)`

Remember a (already verified) peer ticket, keyed by its peerId. Overwrites any older ticket for the same peer.

### `getPeerTicket(store, peerId)`

Look up the remembered ticket for a peer, or null.

### `removePeerTicket(store, peerId)`

Forget a peer's ticket. Returns true if one existed.

### `pruneExpiredPeerTickets(store, now = Date.now()`

Remove tickets whose payload.expiresAt has passed. Returns the removed peerIds.

### `listPeerTicketsByFreshness(store)`

All remembered tickets, most-recently-received first (network plan §38: try freshest known peers first).

### `snapshotPeerTicketStore(store)`

Full, JSON-serializable snapshot of a peer ticket store for OS-side persistence (network plan §38 persistence gap — see this file's header comment; storage itself, e.g. webgpu-os/storage/AppSandbox, is the caller's job). Same shape `listPeerTicketsByFreshness` already returns — exposed under its own name so the persistence contract (snapshot/hydrate pair) stays explicit even if the internal shape changes later.

### `hydratePeerTicketStore(snapshot = [])`

Rebuild a peer ticket store from a previously-persisted snapshotPeerTicketStore() array.
